200720.overview:
A Very Super Mario World is a ROM Hack for the SNES, released in 2015 by SchwerMuta.

There are eight primary worlds, an extra world, a star world that connects various places, and a special, secret world that will test your mettle (and patience.) The goal of every level is to reach the end, and possibly fight a boss such as a koopaling once you do. Many levels have secret exits that are usually opened by taking a key to a keyhole, as per usual Super Mario World fare. There’s many features and gimmicks to many levels, but the feeling of classic Mario platforming typically stays the same. The story is always the same; Mario goes on an adventure to save his friends and the Princess from the evil King Bowser, and along the way, jumps, shoots and even flies through the land in search of the castles controlled by Bowser’s underlings.

202789.overview:
AstroHawk is an Asteroids variant originally created as a homebrew ROM game in the 90s and released for the first time on a cartridge in 2013. Like the original title the player controls a space ship using a top-down view and moved around with bursts of thrust. The screen also scrolls endlessly in all directions as the ship always remain in the middle of the screen. The ship has an unlimited amount of bullets and can shoot in all directions. There are both asteroids and enemies to defeat. A radar in the top left corner of the screen shows what is incoming. The ship has a life meter and can take a few hits.

Unlike the original game there is an open world progression where different sectors can be tackled in any order by selecting them on a world map. There are also some settings that can be defined before entering a level: six types of firing patterns, two types of bombs and three types of shields. The game keeps track of the score.

203070.overview:
A Plumber For All Seasons from Super Mario World. The premise is that each world represents a different season — there's a Spring world, a Summer world, a Fall world, and a Winter world (And some more!). What might set it apart from other hacks is that a lot of resources are made by the author - all the graphics, a bit of ASM, and even some music here and there.

A Plumber For All Seasons features:
• 37 levels with 41 exits.
• Almost entirely custom graphics, all of them hand-made.
• A focus on interesting, season-themed scenery and fun levels.
• An original soundtrack by some of SMWC's finest musicians.
• Rewards and easter eggs for completionists.

208799.overview:
My gift to you, the SMW Central community!


This is a very short hack, I would expect the average playthrough to take at most 1 hour.
All levels are short and are relatively easy without being too free.

This hack has no overworld and instant-retry, it is built with speedrunning in mind.


I hope you enjoy it, happy holidays!

213153.overview:
The first ever collaboration hack created by over 200 users of SMW Central. It is Peach’s birthday, and Mario and Luigi must go and gather eggs to make her a cake. Things aren’t quite as normal as they seem along the way though…

Almost every single thing in this game has been changed and altered included ASM changes.

The hack is now compatible with a real SNES.

214173.overview:
OK here it is A YOSHI'S STORY 2! ... this time for realsies ^^

217058.overview:
ALPHA SPHERE: Director’s Cut is a complete overhaul Horror SMW ROM Hack focused on atmosphere and puzzles. You play as Norma, a girl trying to escape a man known as Dr. Andre when she stumbles across an ancient relic. Now she must provide it a new home before the night time passes. 219433.overview:
Mario finds himself in a dark, abandoned mansion.
Will he be able to find a way out before time will consume him?

417521.overview:

419237.overview:

The object is to destroy all of the robots. To do this, you have to search objects in the game for weapons and other items to help you along the way. Many scenarios require complex thinking and problem solving, rather than just action shooting.

419882.overview:
Hack: Le Avventure di Mario 1
Created by: Silver/Wakana
Release Date: 2011
Exits: 91
Fixed by: SimFan96

This is the fixed version of Le Avventure di Mario 1 by Wakana. This version fixes the latest released version of the hack including broken music and other issues, in addition to this I also included the original Italian translation of the hack.

Fixes provided:
* Fixed broken music included in the game originally which would crash on console and accurate emulators.
* The hack uses fastrom, however the majority of long addresses didn't use fastrom addressing. This has been fixed and will further reduce slowdown in the hack.
* L+R scrolling in levels with the SMB scroll sprite will no longer softlock the game.
* There will no longer be a small flash of color before the Nintendo Presents screen or on level load.
* There's quite a few areas in the hack that can softlock the player where they can't progress through a level until the timer runs out or the player dies, these have been fixed to prevent this from occuring.
* On accurate emulators, if a level has both HDMA and a large amount of dynamic sprites on the screen, the HDMA gradient will start to flicker random colors. This has been fixed by implementing Ice Man's HDMA 3.5 patch.
* Graphical glitches with some Dynamic sprites have been fixed.
* Code that implements multiplication and division registers have been updated to work correctly in accurate emulators.
* Fixed an issue with the pause routine. Originally, if the player paused the game, the music wouldn't mute, but upon unpausing the music would be muted.
* The lightning generator and level ending question mark orb in Wastelands 4 can be rather glitchy. Commonly, if the player touched the level ending question mark orb at the end of this level, layer 3 elements such as the status bar, message box, or overworld border would be permanently glitched until the player resets the game. This issue has been fixed so layer 3 will no longer glitch from completing this level.
* HDMA gradients will no longer appear on the level transition or game over screens.
* The Yoshi's Island Balloon sprites that appear in Castle 7 can be glitchy if they are placed on the beginning or end of a horizontal screen boundary and can cause the player to be randomly teleported. Touching the sprite will no longer randomly teleport the player.
* In the Enchanted Forest cave level, the HDMA wave effect will not appear after passing the midway point, now it will show even upon returning to the level after collecting the midway point.

Known issues:
* Slowdown is still present in the hack.
* Some graphical glitches still appear.

Notes:
* Music was reinserted using AddMusicKFF.
* SFX Echo re-added to levels and other fixes implemented using UberASM patch.

455542.overview: This hack changes every single level (excluding the occasional boss fight) in Arkanoid - Doh It Again to a level featuring a character from the classic Mega Man series. Almost every single classic Mega Man game is represented in some way (excluding 11 and some very obscure titles), with main characters, prominent villains, famous enemies and bosses, and loads of robot masters for you to destroy block by block! Play through every level to get a few surprises at the end in the form of cameo appearances by other popular Mega Man characters.

457637.overview:
The intent of this hack is to elevate General Leo to a deuteragonist role and periodically shift the narrative focus from the main party to him, in order to explore the events on the Imperial side in parallel with the main casts’ actions (kind of like what FF8 did with Laguna). The narrative split continues until Leo and the Returners’ stories intersect, at which point more substantial changes occur, such as Leo surviving and eventually being able to join the party as a permanent member, and the World of Ruin’s story progression being retooled. The overall story and mechanics remain mostly the same, but utilize an expanded ROM and dialogue bank for dozens of new cutscenes and events to expand upon what’s already there, for all characters, not just Leo. Terra’s struggles are also more significantly explored.

This is first and foremost a story hack rather than a gameplay hack. Not to “change” the story, so much as tell it from a different set of eyes, and to give Leo a chance to participate in that story more than he did originally. There are a few new boss fights and some minor adjustments to battle mechanics, as well as a few events that utilize mechanics not present in the original game. But expanding on the original world, characters, and themes while still remaining loyal to them was the goal going into this rather than changing the manner in which the game is played. As such, no characters have been added, replaced, removed, or significantly altered, with the exception of Siegfried, since he served no purpose in the original game and his sprite memory was re-utilized, so he no longer exists. So if you’re a die-hard Siegfried fan, this hack is not for you.

New Features:
-Leo’s sprite recolored to more closely match his menu portrait
-Leo can now become a permanent party member… OR NOT, depending on player choices.
-Mog is now a temporarily-recruitable guest character to open a permanent slot in the roster for Leo.
-Two new events added to the World of Balance featuring Leo as a playable guest character, along with adding him to a third where he wasn’t originally present.
-World of Ruin opens from a different character’s perspective
-Brand new re-recruitment event for Leo in World of Ruin to obtain him as a permanent party member
-Shadow becomes permanently recruitable in the World of Balance
-Over an hour’s worth of new or expanded cutscenes, with over 800 new lines of dialogue
-New retranslation of much of the original script. Woolsey was used as a base and his translation was kept for lines that were “close enough” or whose localization didn’t detract from the original intent. The remainder of the script has been relocalized and refreshed. This is an original retranslation, not one from previous mods.

465639.overview:
Awful Fantasy is basically a retelling of the "geek forum experience" from the early 2000s, relying on a LOT of humor and inside-jokes from that era across multiple forums. The most prolific, of course, being Something Awful.

Every single thing in this game has been changed, and there seems to be no particular rhyme or reason for anything other than "why not?" Some enemies auto-kill themselves, a new spell was intentionally programmed to include both the Relm Sketch bug and the Dischord bug all in one, every character has a superweapon, all sprites are different...

It's actually quite the hacking feat considering tools were not super available back then and we English speakers didn't see any real FF6 hacks that weren't just bug fixes or those weird "super faithful to Japanese" transliterations.

The game will absolutely troll you (don't open the trapped chest in the school or go right at the start of the game in the magitek armor) and makes no apologies for what it is.

One day Lumi the Goblin woke up and realized she was STARVING, so she decided to walk down to the local supermarket to see if they had any gyros. This is her story.

This is a semi-difficult Kaizo light hack. If you had to ask I'd say maybe a 6.5/10 or so? Or a 7? If Quickie is a 1 and Casio is a 10. I dunno, its hard to define difficulty for kaizo hacks, its all in the eye of the beholder. Well I am bad at Kaizo Mario, and this is about a 6.5. So hopefully that'll inform your download choice.

The hack itself is rather chocolatey, though the gimmicks are USUALLY less in ASM and more in sprites and interesting level design. My goal in this hack (and most hacks) is to get people to go "WHAT THE HECK" as soon as they see a level (though usually use a word different than heck), then find out they really like the level anyway

Things this hack has:

Goblins
Trashcans
96 fugumannen (Yes, 96 different fugu. Its my favorite sprite.)
Chocolatey design
Gyros (hopefully!)
Cutscenes where Lumi dyed her hair for 5 minutes cause I couldn't fix that issue lol I dunno
Some humor, depending on how much of a fuddy duddy you are.
No trolls or deadly kaizo blocks. Mischief is fun, trolls are not.
A secret room in every single level, the "Murr Room" of that level

474167.overview:

The Falcon Brazil Team proudly presents the INTERNATIONAL SUPERSTAR SOCCER COLLECTION! An unprecedented initiative that imagines a scenario where the developer released separate versions by continent. Without overlapping national teams between the International and continental versions, the collection expands the game's ecosystem to an incredible 135 exclusive national teams, maintaining the classic skill balance and iconic fictional names that marked an era due to 16-bit copyright restrictions. This definitive collection is our gift to the community as we celebrate 7 years of history in the romhacker scene, serving as a definitive version of the immortal classic ISS. Developed specifically for online tournaments, it is also 100% compatible for solo gameplay on emulators, Everdrives, or even for those who want to produce their own physical cartridge!

The time has come to ignite the greatest rivalries on the planet with AMERICAN SUPERSTAR SOCCER! Bringing together the fervent passion of the Americas (South, Central and North), this version delivers epic clashes of pure skill and refined technique for the classic engine we all love.

474254.overview:
If you're a fan of afternoons spent on virtual soccer fields in the 16-bit era, get ready for an incredible new experience. The classic and unforgettable nostalgia of International Superstar Soccer has just been given a brand new makeover with the American Soccer ROM.

Masterfully developed by editor Thiago Toellyton, from the acclaimed Falcon Brasil Team, this project is a true love letter to those passionate about retro football and romhacks.

The great differentiator of American Soccer is its geographical focus. The ROM faithfully follows the mold of Konami's original masterpiece, even maintaining the charm of players with fictional names — a licensing limitation of the time that ended up becoming a trademark and charismatic feature of the game.

However, instead of featuring a world tournament with countries from all corners of the globe, the game focuses exclusively on the national teams of the American continents. It's the perfect opportunity for you to simulate the historic rivalries of a real Copa América or Gold Cup directly on your console or emulator!

480031.overview:
QoL hack for Actraiser, focused on improving the Simulation side.

Features:

* Choose Your Own Path: all six lands can be selected for their first action stage from a fresh playthrough
* Fillmore remains the recommended first land for the normal difficulty curve
* Later lands can be much harder at a low Master level
* Second-stage and Death Heim progression remain normal
* Before a land's first action stage is cleared, that land shows 000 / 0000
* After that land's first action stage is cleared, the city denominator unlocks that land's Redone maximum
* Current population grows normally from the founders toward that city maximum
* Real action-stage scores remain unchanged
* Current population is not force-written to maximum
* Growth resources are kept high enough for maximum expansion
* Housing population math supports full city growth
* Support bottlenecks are reduced so Wheat and bridge routing do not permanently block max population
* Five valid Aitos and Marahna construction squares are enabled
* Normal SP, score, status, and menu numbers are left alone

480111.overview:
This is a hack that changes various gameplay mechanics for the Master including:

* The X Button now allows spells to be cast instantly much like the previous title
* Maximum spell points increased from 10 to 20
* Spell points are regained upon death if less were available than the starting amount
* The spell charging system has been reworked to allow casting without a spell point cost, as such the charge length begins at 4 ‘Charge Ticks’
* Spell rebalance
* Firespray remains unchanged
* Aerial Explosion damage increased from 2 to 3
* Triple Fireball damage reduced from 3 to 2
* Shield damage increased from 1 to 2
* Lightning Ball damage increase from 2 and 4 to 5 and 7
* Air Projectile damage increased from 4 and 2 to 6 and 4
* Phoenix Dive damage increased from 6 to 8
* Earn rewards for each major boss beaten
* Deception (Palace 2) - Spell charge time reduction by 1 ‘Charge Tick’
* Greed (Stormrook) - Spell charge time reduction by 1 ‘Charge Tick’
* Envy (Altheria) - Starting spell points increased by 2
* Gluttony (Demon’s Cave) - Starting spell points increased by 2
* Sloth (Benefic) - Damage knockback now results in a special animation that allows control to be regained more quickly
* Wrath (Almetha) - Damage reduction, damage over 2 is now reduced by 1
* Pride (Tower of Souls) - Gain the bladebeam normally given in Deathheim
* Intro Tanzra (Demo) - Gain a permanent extra life
* Instant death spikes no longer kill instantly with the exception of moving spike walls that chase you, instead they do a maximum of 8 damage or 7 with damage reduction
* Any other stage hazards that deal over 8 damage have been reduced to 8 or 7 with damage reduction
* The password that allows you to fight Tanzra from the introduction demo (BJQX YRKC DLSZ) now works for any difficulty selected
* Entering the Tower of Souls early is now possible on normal and hard difficulties by holding Select when talking to the people of Humbleton
* Deathheim is now locked behind all levels instead of only Tower of Souls
* The skidding animation from gliding into the ground has been greatly reduced to allow more player control
* The character has much more air control than before, allowing for free movement in the air with some exceptions
* The stage timer is now stopped

These changes will make the game much easier as well as allow for new routing opportunities with the different rewards available. Having Intro Tanzra and the Tower of Souls freely available from the beginning should provide some new experiences. Despite the Triple Fireball spell’s damage being reduced by 1, it is still one of the best spells available. Hopefully this hack breathes some new life into ActRaiser 2.
